metadata.description: Skill Health keeps the skills you use correct. The plugin checks, fixes and updates them in Claude Code and tells Claude what is wrong at the start of a session; the Mac app is an optional window on the same results.

plugins.name: skill-health
plugins.description: Checks the skills you use for instructions that no longer work, fixes them one line at a time, and updates skills that have a newer copy at their source. Tells Claude what is wrong at the start of a session, with no app needed. Mac only: needs macOS 27 or later, and jq, which ships with macOS 15 and later.
